# Dhiraj Rajput — Portfolio & Knowledge Base

> Cybersecurity & Full-Stack Engineer. Published Researcher in Springer Nature. MIT-WPU Pune, India.

## Executive Summary
Dhiraj Rajput is a software engineer and cybersecurity researcher based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. He builds high-throughput distributed systems in Go and Python, modern interactive frontends in React and TypeScript, and published groundbreaking assistive technology research combining computer vision with LLMs for real-time blind navigation in Springer Nature (Cureus Journal of Computer Science).

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **Cybersecurity & Defense:** Penetration testing, intrusion detection, red team simulation, LLM privacy proxies, PII sanitization, credential & access audits.
- **Distributed Systems & Backend:** High-throughput streaming data pipelines with Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, TimescaleDB, Redis, Go microservices, FastAPI, and Django.
- **Frontend & UI Engineering:** React 18, TypeScript, Vite, CSS Modules, high-performance web animations, responsive design, WCAG accessibility (a11y).
- **Edge AI & Assistive Tech:** Edge computer vision (YOLOv8, OpenCV), multimodal LLM reasoning, Raspberry Pi wearable prototypes, audio spatial feedback.

## Peer-Reviewed Publication
- **Title:** "Integrating Computer Vision and Large Language Models for Real-Time Blind Navigation"
- **Publisher:** Cureus Journal of Computer Science — Springer Nature (2026)
- **DOI:** https://doi.org/10.7759/s44389-026-00265-x
- **Summary:** Wearable, hands-free assistive device pairing edge computer vision with multimodal LLM reasoning for real-time obstacle annotation and navigation for visually impaired users.

## Selected Open Source Projects
1. **Neo-Analytics:**
   - Real-time astronomical telemetry pipeline using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, and TimescaleDB with automated risk evaluation.
   - Code: https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/neo-project
2. **RakshaNetra:**
   - Proactive client-edge PII interceptor proxy that sanitizes sensitive tokens before prompts reach external LLM endpoints.
   - Code: https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/rakshak-pii
3. **RIFT (Remote Intrusion Framework):**
   - Security operations and remote intrusion simulation framework built with Go, Django, Celery, and Redis.
   - Code: https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/rift-agent
4. **BidForge:**
   - Multi-agent LLM pipeline generating comprehensive enterprise proposals and bids from request documents.
   - Code: https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/bidforge
5. **Omniscient:**
   - Real-time collaborative task management engine powered by LLaMA and WebSockets.
   - Code: https://github.com/dhiraj-rajput/omniscient
